controls.name: shard-partitions
controls.find: a.g == key && (src == 0 || a.s == src) && (pred == 0 || a.p == pred)
controls.replace: a.g == key && shard == 0 && (src == 0 || a.s == src) && (pred == 0 || a.p == pred)
controls.classification: decision: the scan reads its shard argument (only shard 0 answers); as built shard is never read (ME5)

controls.name: default-reads-every-graph
controls.find: a.g == key && (src == 0 || a.s == src) && (pred == 0 || a.p == pred)
controls.replace: (a.g == key || key == 0) && (src == 0 || a.s == src) && (pred == 0 || a.p == pred)
controls.classification: decision: MatchEdges reads the default graph's key 0 as every graph (the pre-spec-230 behavior the EdgeScan header records)

controls.name: empty-predicate-matches-none
controls.find: a.g == key && (src == 0 || a.s == src) && (pred == 0 || a.p == pred)
controls.replace: a.g == key && (src == 0 || a.s == src) && a.p == pred
controls.classification: decision: an empty predicate matches no edge (MatchEdges called from SQL with '' before 4.6.0 R269)

controls.name: all-graphs-default-only
controls.classification: decision: the all-graphs scan reads only the default graph

controls.name: no-select-check
controls.classification: guard: the SQL entries skip RequireSelect / RequireWrite (the pre-4.6.0 R289/R293 behavior)

controls.name: scan-exposes-weight
controls.find: match pl { Plan::Rows => a.w, Plan::Scan => None }
controls.replace: match pl { Plan::Rows => a.w, Plan::Scan => a.w }
controls.classification: reader: the edge-scan alias exposes its `w` column for `r.weight` (the bug-cyp-133 repair direction)

controls.name: sql-entry-unchecked
controls.classification: guard: only the Python CALL checks the direction and weight property; the SQL entry would search (or answer no path)

controls.name: nul-read-as-empty
controls.find: pub open spec fn sql_end(empty: bool, id: int) -> End { if empty { End::Nul } else { End::Id(id) } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn sql_end(empty: bool, id: int) -> End { if empty { End::Missing } else { End::Id(id) } }
controls.classification: provider/input: SQL's '' reaches the body as "" (as $Translate($Char(0)) would make it; the bug-str-112 repair direction)

controls.name: count-written-rows
controls.find: pub open spec fn backfill_count(st: Bf) -> nat { structural(st).len() }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn backfill_count(st: Bf) -> nat { structural(st).filter(|t: Tri| !st.rows.contains_key(t)).len() }
controls.classification: effect: the backfill answers the rows it wrote (ADMIN_GUIDE:413's reading; the bug-tmp-107 repair direction)

controls.name: optout-backfilled
controls.find: pub open spec fn structural(st: Bf) -> Set<Tri> { st.tout.filter(|t: Tri| !st.optout.contains((t.0, t.2))) }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn structural(st: Bf) -> Set<Tri> { st.tout }
controls.classification: guard: the backfill ignores the temporal-only registrations (TemporalPolicy.IsStructuralKey)

controls.name: backfill-marks-existing
controls.find: |t: Tri| if st.rows.contains_key(t) { st.rows[t] } else { true })
controls.classification: effect: the backfill marks every row it walks, an explicit edge's included (AssertTemporalRow's NOT EXISTS guard removed)

controls.name: rebuild-refusal-answers-zero
controls.find: Schema::Present => if build_priv { RbAns::Ok(4) } else { RbAns::RaisesNamingTable },
controls.replace: Schema::Present => if build_priv { RbAns::Ok(4) } else { RbAns::Ok(0) },
controls.classification: effect: a refused BUILD INDEX answers 0 (the pre-4.6.0 behavior)
